# Readshot

Readshot is a free, offline screenshot, scrolling-capture, and OCR app for macOS 14 or later.

## Links

- [Website](https://readshot.pawanpaudel.com.np/)
- [CLI docs](https://readshot.pawanpaudel.com.np/cli.html)
- [MCP docs](https://readshot.pawanpaudel.com.np/mcp.html)
- [Source](https://github.com/pawanpaudel93/readshot)
- [Releases](https://github.com/pawanpaudel93/readshot/releases)

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://readshot.pawanpaudel.com.np/install.sh | bash
```
